import hashlib
import requests, json

API_KEY = "your_api_key"
# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号，为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"chat_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()
MODEL   = "hy4-preview"
URL     = "http://api.aihub.woa.com/standard/v1/chat/completions"
HEADERS = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}?cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}",
    # 透传协议才需要 provider： f"Bearer {API_KEY}?provider=taiji"
}

body = {
    "model": MODEL,
    "messages": [
        {"role": "user", "content": "用一句话解释什么是分布式锁"},
    ],
    "reasoning_effort": "high",
    "prompt_cache_key": "hy4-preview-example",
    "max_completion_tokens": 4096,
    "stream": False,
    "temperature": 0.9,
    "top_p": 1.0,
    # "stop": ["。"],
    # "seed": 42,
    # "frequency_penalty": 0,
    # "presence_penalty": 0,
    # "parallel_tool_calls": True,  # 实测不生效，仍可能返回多个 tool_calls
    # "extra_body": {"top_k": 50},  # 官方协议无 top_k，平台扩展字段
    # "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
    # "tools": [
    #     {"type": "function", "function": {
    #         "name": "get_weather",
    #         "description": "获取城市天气",
    #         "parameters": {"type": "object",
    #             "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
    #             "required": ["city"]}}}
    # ],
    # "tool_choice": "auto",
}

r = requests.post(URL, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=180,
                   stream=body["stream"])

if body["stream"]:
    r.encoding = "utf-8"
    reasoning_started = False
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if (not line or not line.startswith("data: ")
                or line == "data: [DONE]"):
            continue
        try:
            delta = json.loads(line[6:])["choices"][0].get("delta", {})
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError):
            continue
        rc = delta.get("reasoning_content") or ""
        c  = delta.get("content") or ""
        if rc:
            if not reasoning_started:
                print("[Thinking] ", end="", flush=True)
                reasoning_started = True
            print(rc, end="", flush=True)
        if c:
            if reasoning_started:
                print("\n[Answer]   ", end="", flush=True)
                reasoning_started = False
            print(c, end="", flush=True)
    print()
else:
    d = r.json()
    msg = d["choices"][0]["message"]
    if msg.get("reasoning_content"):
        print("[Thinking]", msg["reasoning_content"])
        print()
    print("[Answer]  ", msg.get("content") or "")

import hashlib
from litellm import completion

API_KEY = "your_api_key"
# 平台底层维护了多个上游账号，为了保证亲和性 cache_task_id 参数配置能保证 cache 缓存命中率, 具体参数解释 https://iwiki.woa.com/p/4051772719 务必替换成cache_task_id=<32位MD5>
CACHE_TASK_ID = hashlib.md5(f"chat_demo:{API_KEY}".encode()).hexdigest()
MODEL = "hy4-preview"
ENDPOINT = "openapi/v2/"

response = completion(
    model="openai/" + MODEL,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "你好"}],
    api_base=f"http://api.aihub.woa.com/{ENDPOINT}",
    api_key=f"{API_KEY}?provider=taiji&cache_task_id={CACHE_TASK_ID}",
    stream=False,
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

cache_guidance.affinity_rule: 同一对话上下文复用同一个值，不同对话必须用不同值。该值只影响平台选号：相同值的请求会被路由到同一个上游账号。
cache_guidance.note: 两者需配合使用：cache_task_id 保证请求落到同一账号，prompt 缓存参数才可能在厂商侧命中；只设其一均无缓存收益。affinity_wire_format 为空表示平台尚未对外明确传参方式，请勿自行猜测。
